name: Datascoop – Smart Restock
author: datascoopservices

sections.description:
Datascoop – Smart Restock helps WooCommerce stores collect customer interest when products are out of stock and when shoppers want a price-drop alert.

Basic version includes:

  • Back-in-stock alert form for unavailable simple products and selected unavailable variations.
  • Price-drop alert form in the product summary area.
  • Logged-in customer email capture.
  • Guest email capture with consent checkbox.
  • Email notifications when products return to stock or reach the customer target price.
  • Subscriber list and email logs inside WordPress admin.

This WordPress.org version is fully functional for the features included in this plugin. It does not require a license key, does not contact a Datascoop server, and does not send site/admin data to any external service.

For PRO feature details, visit:
https://datascoopservices.com/smart-restock-plugin-for-woocommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Datascoop Restock > Settings.
  4. Enable out-of-stock and price-drop alerts as required.
sections.faq:
Does the basic version require a license key?

No. The basic WordPress.org version does not require a license key and does not include a license tab.

Does this plugin send data to Datascoop or any external service?

No. This WordPress.org version stores subscribers, settings, and email logs locally in the WordPress database and does not make external service calls.

Where do the forms appear?

The out-of-stock form appears on unavailable simple products and selected unavailable variations. The price-drop form appears in the product summary area.
sections.changelog:

  • Keeps Basic vs PRO information with the product details link.
  • Uses only local WordPress/WooCommerce functionality and does not contact external services.
